newsitem.title: USA: NN Ball sees FY97 revs flat vs FY96.
newsitem.headline: NN Ball sees FY97 revs flat vs FY96.

text.p: NN Ball & Roller Inc, reporting lower third-quarter earnings, said revenues in 1997 would be level with anticipated fiscal 1996 revenues, due to reduced demand in Europe and higher customer inventories.

"The impact if the current soft European economies on industrial production, the excess inventory builds by certain customers and a slowing in the rate outsourcing captive production has required us to adjust our 1997 business plan. At this time, we expect that our 1997 revenue volumes will approximate the level reached in 1996," the company's president said in a released statement.
James Mitchell went on to call 1997 "a transition year" for the company.

"Although our anticipated 1996 revenue volumes and current outlook for top-line volume are falling short of our mid-teen growth objective, they do not reflect the long-term growth potential if NN Ball & Roller," the president said.
He said the company was pursuing acquisitions as well as enhancements to facilities and production.
